description: Column definitions and field access boundaries for Delhi V6.1 synthetic dataset

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: amount
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Defrauded amount in INR

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: log_amount
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Log-transformed fraud amount log1p(amount)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: amount_bucket
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Binned amount: micro, low, medium, high, severe

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: fraud_type
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Modus operandi (9 categories)

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: payment_channel
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Primary channel: upi, imps, neft, rtgs, card_p2p, crypto_p2p

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: event_timestamp
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Timestamp of fraud initiation

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: reported_at
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Timestamp when formal complaint was lodged

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: reporting_delay_minutes
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Elapsed duration until complaint filing

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim's revenue district

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_lat
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim latitude coordinate

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_lon
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim longitude coordinate

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: victim_bank_group
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Victim banking entity group

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transaction_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Total transfer events in laundering chain

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transaction_hop_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Graph hop distance from victim to terminal mule

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: beneficiary_account_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of unique layer-1 beneficiary accounts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: mule_account_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Total intermediate and terminal mule accounts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: distinct_bank_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of distinct banking institutions involved

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: terminal_mule_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Revenue district of terminal mule account branch

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: account_district_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of distinct districts across laundering accounts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: dominant_account_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: District with highest share of accounts in chain

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: dominant_account_district_share
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Proportion of accounts belonging to dominant district

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: beneficiary_geo_consistency
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Spatial coherence between layer-1 accounts and flow endpoints

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: terminal_vs_majority_account_distance_km
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Distance between terminal account and chain centroid

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: cross_district_transfer_count
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Number of transfers spanning district boundaries

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: geographic_dispersion_score
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Standard geographic dispersion radius of laundering chain

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transaction_velocity
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Transfers executed per hour

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: transfer_burst_score
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Transfer concentration in short 15-minute bursts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: graph_depth
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Longest directed branch length in laundering DAG

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: graph_branching_factor
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Average out-degree of laundering nodes

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: night_activity_ratio
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Proportion of activity between 22:00 and 06:00

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: weekend_flag
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Binary flag for weekend activity

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: money_flow_net_displacement_km
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Net straight-line distance from victim origin to terminal mule branch

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: money_flow_total_path_km
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Cumulative geographic distance across all hops

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: money_flow_backtrack_ratio
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Ratio of net displacement to total path length

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: dominant_flow_district
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: District with highest traversal frequency in money flow

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: terminal_flow_alignment_score
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Directional cosine alignment of money flow vector towards terminal district

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: downstream_geo_concentration
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Herfindahl concentration index of downstream accounts

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: cross_district_hop_ratio
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Ratio of cross-district hops to total hops

PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.name: terminal_displacement_from_origin_km
PRE_EVENT_FEATURE.description: Centroid distance of terminal mule branch from victim origin

CONTEXT_FEATURE.name: historical_district_crime_density
CONTEXT_FEATURE.description: Prior 90d normalized cybercrime density for victim district

CONTEXT_FEATURE.name: commercial_hub_proximity_km
CONTEXT_FEATURE.description: Distance from victim to nearest major commercial cluster

LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.name: generator_district_distribution
LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.description: Internal multinomial probability vector over 11 districts

LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.name: generator_cluster_distribution
LATENT_GENERATION_ONLY.description: Internal multinomial probability vector over 60 clusters

TARGET.name: realized_cashout_district
TARGET.description: Revenue district where cash-out materialized (11 districts)

TARGET.name: realized_cashout_cluster_id
TARGET.description: Operational cluster ID of cash-out event (1..60)

TARGET.name: realized_cashout_minutes
TARGET.description: Elapsed duration in minutes from fraud event to cash-out

constraints.geographic_consistency_rule: realized_cashout_district MUST match the district of realized_cashout_cluster_id for 100% of cases
